display.purpose: Page titles and collection names. Instrument Serif, the largest type on a screen.

title.purpose: Subsection and card-group headings in Instrument Serif.

body.purpose: Default UI and reading text. Inter at 14px with cv11/ss01 stylistic sets.

label.purpose: Form labels, metadata, and button text. Inter medium at 13px, never uppercased.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Fades in on a set card on hover, hover-capable devices only. Never present at rest.

shadows.name: dropdown
shadows.purpose: Menus and popovers that genuinely float above the page.

shadows.name: banner
shadows.purpose: Upward shadow for the public-view banner anchored to the viewport edge.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out for entrances and feedback.

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: Default for color and border state changes on buttons and inputs.

motion.name: ease-vaul
motion.purpose: Drawer and sheet slide-in easing (Vaul modals).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Tonal-inversion call-to-action: near-white fill on the dark UI, capsule-shaped.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #f4f4f5; color: #18181b; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out, opacity 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a1a1aa; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bordered alternative action on a neutral surface, capsule-shaped.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #18181b; color: #f4f4f5; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #3f3f46; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #27272a; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a1a1aa; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Set Card
components.description: The catalog's signature unit: a square image well over a name, set number, and a status/owner metadata row. Flat at rest, lifts on hover.

components.css: .ds-set-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 200px; background: #18181b; border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-set-card:hover { border-color: #3f3f46; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 30%), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 30%); } .ds-set-card__img { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; } .ds-set-card__well { position: absolute; inset: 12px; border-radius: 4px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, #27272a, #18181b); } .ds-set-card__body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 8px 12px 12px; } .ds-set-card__name { margin: 0; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #f4f4f5; } .ds-set-card__num { margin: 0; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; color: #71717a; } .ds-set-card__meta { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin-top: 4px; } .ds-set-card__badge { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(34 197 94 / 15%); color: #22c55e; } .ds-set-card__owner { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 4px; border: 1px solid #3f3f46; border-radius: 6px; color: #a1a1aa; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line field on a neutral surface with a 1px border; focus shifts the border to the interactive tone.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 220px; height: 40px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 8px 12px; background: #18181b; color: #f4f4f5; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; border: 1px solid #3f3f46; border-radius: 8px; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #71717a; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #f4f4f5; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Capsule-shaped filter toggle for status and owner; selected state brightens the text.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 12px; background: #1f1f23; color: #a1a1aa; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #27272a; } .ds-chip--selected { color: #f4f4f5; border-color: #3f3f46; }

components.description: A floating, fully-rounded bar that sticks a small margin below the viewport top and reads as a discrete object.

narrative.overview: Eggo is a frame around a collection. Like a well-built shelf, the interface lines the sets up cleanly, holds them at a comfortable distance, and otherwise gets out of the way. The system is dark-first, built on near-black surfaces so each set image reads like an object lit on a dark wall, and the chrome stays quiet enough to disappear (light is a fully supported mode; the default theme preference follows the OS). The system is monochrome by doctrine: a neutral gray ramp, Instrument Serif for every heading, Inter for everything else, and no decorative accent color. The only saturated colors are the four functional status signals. It explicitly rejects the generic SaaS dashboard, the childish toy-store look, the spreadsheet tool, and the cluttered marketplace.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first, monochrome neutrals; saturated color is functional only.
Editorial pairing: Instrument Serif headings at normal weight, Inter body at 14px.
Flat at rest; depth comes from tonal layering, with shadow reserved for hover.
Tactile, confident controls: solid fills, capsule buttons, clear hover response.
The set image is always the loudest element on screen.

rules.name: The Monochrome Rule
rules.body: The interface has no accent hue. If a color other than the gray ramp appears, it is a status signal carrying specific meaning, or it is a bug. The legacy orange (#f97316) is not the brand and must not be reintroduced as decoration.

rules.name: The Image-Is-The-Color Rule
rules.body: Color on screen comes from the set photographs. The UI stays neutral so those photographs are never out-shouted.

rules.name: The Light-Serif Rule
rules.body: Headings are serif at normal weight (400). A bold serif heading is forbidden; emphasis comes from size, never from weighting the serif.

rules.name: The Capped-Measure Rule
rules.body: Body copy never runs wider than 75ch. Eggo's content is short by nature, so a stray full-width paragraph reads as a mistake.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces carry no shadow at rest. A shadow is feedback, it answers a hover or marks something that truly floats (menu, banner). A resting card with a drop shadow is wrong; raise it with a lighter tonal step instead.

dos: Do keep the system monochrome. Structure with the gray ramp; let set photographs supply the only real color.
Do set every heading in Instrument Serif at weight 400.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest and convey depth with a lighter tonal step.
Do make buttons fully capsule-shaped (border-radius: 9999px) in the Mono theme.
Do keep all borders at 1px hairlines.
Do reserve the four status colors for status badges and validation only.
donts: Don't reintroduce the legacy orange (#f97316) or any decorative accent hue. The Monochrome Rule is the brand.
Don't build a generic SaaS dashboard: no hero-metric blocks, no gradient text or gradient accents, no identical icon-card grids.
Don't make it a childish toy-store: no primary-color overload, no bubbly or rounded display fonts, no cartoon styling.
Don't turn the collection into a spreadsheet: sets are shown as images in cards, never collapsed into cold table rows.
Don't let a screen become a cluttered marketplace: no dense, noisy, ad-style listings competing for attention.
Don't put a drop shadow on a resting surface. A shadow is hover feedback or it marks something that truly floats.
Don't use a colored side-stripe (border-left/border-right greater than 1px) on cards, list items, or alerts.
Don't bold the serif headings. Emphasize with size, not weight.
